messages:
marta: hey team — tiny onprem auth tweak landed in my PR, asking for a quick security glance before I slot into the merge queue. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/8342

marta: change scope: reduce service account token lifetime + optional KMS key selector for onprem deploys. no infra changes, just config parsing + unit tests.

marta: fyi it touches env parsing and secrets loader. quick snippet:```yaml
ONPREM_TOKEN_TTL=300
KMS_KEY_ID=projects/prod/locations/us/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/onprem-1
```

marta: @jess @kevin would love a thumbs-up or any redaction/egress flags. aiming to merge 09:30 PT. :clock9:

jess: skimmed — looks pretty small. can you add a short log-redaction unit test? last time we had a token leak in logs and it bit us.

marta: yup, added a test in loader_test.go — asserts token not present in logs. link in PR description.

kevin: quick question: does this change require any VPC egress policy updates? i.e. will the KMS selector call out to any new endpoints?

marta: no new external endpoints. KMS selector uses existing KMS proxy inside the VPC. only change is passing an optional key id string, no network calls at parse-time.

sam: pinging privacy: @jess any concerns about TTL default of 300s for onprem tenants? might affect audit windows.

jess: 300s is fine but request we store TTL change in audit events so operations can track it. add an audit event line when token minted/renewed.

marta: added audit event emit in token manager, sample event: `{"evt":"token_issued","ttl":300,"svc":"inference-proxy"}`. kept PII-free.

security-bot: automated-scan: secrets-scan passed. no high-risk findings in changed files.

kevin: lgtm from infra side assuming jess is happy with audit test. :+1:

jess: lgtm, please re-run smoke on staging after merge.

marta: thanks all — merging into merge-queue now, will run the staging smoke and update this thread with outcome. :rocket:

marta: staging smoke completed, no regressions. merged at 09:32 PT. leaving note for oncall to watch token metrics for next 2 hours.

kevin: noted, will keep an eye on token churn graphs.

security-bot: deploy-bot: new deploy to staging started at 2026-03-17T17:10:12Z

marta: closing thread — thanks for fast reviews! :tada:
